VBO:0200992.summary: Enthusiastic about digging in the sand, Tilly the Patterpoo joined Neil Morris and his wife on coastal walks on the Isle of Man. In his 2020 account, Morris described a dog who avoided the noisy sea but loved splashing in the calm, shallow pools left by the tide. Patterpoo is a name for a Patterdale Terrier–Poodle cross.
VBO:0200992.shortDescription: A Patterdale–Poodle cross; Neil Morris’s Tilly enjoyed beach digging and calm tidal pools while avoiding the noisy sea.
